_comment: Configure paths to real geology/soil rasters here. Leave empty strings to use synthetic layers.
_geology_note: Recommended: GLIM (Global Lithological Map) or WHYMAP hydrogeology. Expect integer class rasters with codes matching GEOLOGY_PERM_LUT in run_hf.py.
_soil_note: Recommended: HWSD v1.2 or iSDA-Africa soil texture. Expect integer class rasters.
